accumulation.name: Accumulation
accumulation.description: Large operators (smart money) absorb supply from weak hands after a prolonged downtrend. Price is compressed into a trading range as institutions build positions without dramatically moving price.
accumulation.price_behavior: Sideways range with false breakdowns (springs) and failed breakouts
accumulation.volume_behavior: Decreasing volume during range; elevated volume on tests of support; volume dry-up on markup initiation
identification_criteria: Prior downtrend has ended with a Selling Climax (SC)
Automatic Rally (AR) creates the top of the trading range
Secondary Test (ST) retests SC area on lower volume
Price oscillates between SC low and AR high
Spring (false breakdown below support) may occur
Volume decreases as range matures
Spread narrows toward end of range

tradeable_signals.description: Price briefly breaks below the trading range support on low volume then quickly reverses back into range
tradeable_signals.entry: long on reclaim of support after spring
tradeable_signals.target: top of trading range and beyond

tradeable_signals.signal: Last Point of Support (LPS) after Sign of Strength
tradeable_signals.description: Price breaks above trading range (SOS), pulls back to former resistance now acting as support on low volume
Price retests the Selling Climax area on reduced volume confirming supply is exhausted

transition_to_markup.trigger: Sign of Strength (SOS) — price breaks above AR high with expanding volume
transition_to_markup.confirmation: Pullback to former resistance holds as support (LPS); volume dries up on pullback
transition_to_markup.failure_risk: Price breaks below SC low invalidating accumulation; re-enter markdown phase

markup.name: Markup
markup.description: Price trends upward as demand overwhelms supply. Smart money has completed accumulation and price rises to seek new equilibrium at higher levels.
markup.duration: weeks to years depending on timeframe
markup.price_behavior: Higher Highs and Higher Lows; healthy pullbacks to prior resistance turned support
markup.volume_behavior: Volume expands on rallies; contracts on pullbacks; potential climax volume near top
identification_criteria: Clear break above accumulation range with volume expansion
Pullbacks find support at prior resistance levels
Higher High Higher Low structure on all lower timeframes
Volume confirms each new high
Sentiment transitions from bearish to bullish in public

tradeable_signals.description: Price returns to the top of the accumulation range after breaking out
tradeable_signals.entry: long at former resistance now support
tradeable_signals.target: next significant resistance or measured move

tradeable_signals.description: Price consolidates briefly in a flag/pennant pattern before continuing markup
tradeable_signals.entry: long on breakout from consolidation with volume

transition_to_distribution.trigger: Buying Climax (BC) — large spread up candle on extremely high volume with reversal
transition_to_distribution.confirmation: Automatic Reaction (AR) creates distribution range low; price fails to make new highs
transition_to_distribution.failure_risk: If markup continues without BC, distribution phase may be subtle

distribution.name: Distribution
distribution.description: Large operators sell their accumulated positions to the public (weak hands) who are now bullish after the markup phase. Supply exceeds demand but price appears to consolidate.
distribution.price_behavior: Sideways range with false breakouts (upthrusts) at the highs
distribution.volume_behavior: High volume on upward moves but price makes little progress; volume on down moves is concerning
identification_criteria: Buying Climax (BC) after extended markup
Automatic Reaction (AR) creates the bottom of the distribution range
Secondary Test (ST) of the BC on lower volume
Upthrust After Distribution (UTAD) — false breakout above range on weak volume
Price oscillates in range with narrowing spreads
Failed rallies with easy downside

tradeable_signals.description: Price spikes above the trading range on weak volume then falls back below range high
tradeable_signals.entry: short on return below range high after upthrust
tradeable_signals.target: bottom of trading range and beyond

tradeable_signals.signal: Last Point of Supply (LPSY) after Sign of Weakness
tradeable_signals.description: Price breaks below distribution range (SOW), rallies back to former support now resistance on low volume

transition_to_markdown.trigger: Sign of Weakness (SOW) — price breaks below AR low with expanding volume
transition_to_markdown.confirmation: Pullback to former support fails to hold; volume expands on the down leg
transition_to_markdown.failure_risk: Price breaks above BC high invalidating distribution; resume markup phase

markdown.name: Markdown
markdown.description: Price trends downward as supply overwhelms demand. Weak hands are trapped long and forced to sell, accelerating the decline.
markdown.duration: weeks to years depending on timeframe
markdown.price_behavior: Lower Highs and Lower Lows; rallies fail at prior support turned resistance
markdown.volume_behavior: Volume expands on declines; contracts on rallies; potential selling climax near bottom
identification_criteria: Clear break below distribution range with volume expansion
Rallies fail at prior support now resistance levels
Lower High Lower Low structure
Sentiment transitions from bullish to bearish in public
Selling climax potential approaching support zones

tradeable_signals.description: Price returns to the bottom of the distribution range after breaking down
tradeable_signals.entry: short at former support now resistance
tradeable_signals.target: next significant support or measured move

tradeable_signals.description: Brief sharp rally on low volume after a sharp decline
tradeable_signals.entry: short as rally fades at resistance

transition_to_accumulation.trigger: Selling Climax (SC) — large spread down candle on extremely high volume with reversal
transition_to_accumulation.confirmation: Automatic Rally (AR) and Secondary Test (ST) of SC area on low volume
transition_to_accumulation.failure_risk: Decline continues below SC invalidating potential accumulation

spring.definition: A price move below the support of the trading range that quickly reverses back into the range
spring.purpose: Shakes out weak longs before the markup phase; allows smart money to buy remaining supply at low prices
spring.volume_requirement: Low to moderate volume on the break; volume should not confirm the breakdown
spring.confirmation: Quick reclaim of support; subsequent Sign of Strength (SOS)

trade_setup.entry: long on close back above support or on next HL formation
trade_setup.target: top of accumulation range and measured move beyond

upthrust.definition: A price move above the resistance of the trading range that quickly reverses back into the range
upthrust.purpose: Traps weak shorts and attracts breakout buyers before the markdown phase; allows smart money to sell into strength
upthrust.volume_requirement: Low to moderate volume on the break; volume should not confirm the breakout
upthrust.confirmation: Quick return below resistance; subsequent Sign of Weakness (SOW)

trade_setup.entry: short on close back below resistance or on next LH formation
trade_setup.target: bottom of distribution range and measured move beyond

phase_transition_risks.description: During markup, price may pause in a secondary accumulation range before continuing higher; can be mistaken for distribution
phase_transition_risks.differentiation: Volume and spread behavior on rallies vs declines within the range; location in overall trend context

phase_transition_risks.description: During markdown, price may pause in a secondary distribution range before continuing lower; can be mistaken for accumulation
phase_transition_risks.differentiation: Volume and spread behavior on rallies vs declines within the range; location in overall trend context

phase_transition_risks.description: Calling a breakdown a spring when supply is still present; price continues lower after re-entry
phase_transition_risks.mitigation: Require volume dry-up on the break and a decisive reversal back into range before acting

phase_transition_risks.description: Calling a breakout an upthrust when demand is still present; price continues higher after short entry
phase_transition_risks.mitigation: Require volume non-confirmation on the break and a decisive return into range before acting

phase_transition_risks.description: Lower timeframe phases may not align with higher timeframe context; trading against higher timeframe trend
phase_transition_risks.mitigation: Always identify current phase on at least two timeframes; align lower timeframe trades with higher timeframe phase

agent_rules.condition: price in sideways range following a downtrend with declining volume and spring pattern
agent_rules.action: classify phase as ACCUMULATION; bias long setups at range support and spring reversals

agent_rules.condition: price breaking above accumulation range with volume expansion
agent_rules.action: classify phase as MARKUP; bias long on pullbacks to breakout level

agent_rules.condition: price in sideways range following a markup with high volume non-progress and upthrust pattern
agent_rules.action: classify phase as DISTRIBUTION; bias short setups at range resistance and upthrust reversals

agent_rules.condition: price breaking below distribution range with volume expansion
agent_rules.action: classify phase as MARKDOWN; bias short on rallies to breakdown level

agent_rules.condition: spring pattern identified — price dips below support on low volume and reverses
agent_rules.action: trigger long setup; set stop below spring low; target range top minimum

agent_rules.condition: upthrust pattern identified — price spikes above resistance on low volume and reverses
agent_rules.action: trigger short setup; set stop above upthrust high; target range bottom minimum
escalate to higher timeframe context; do not trade against higher timeframe phase
